beats.text: No fuel. No explosions. Just magnets and wire.
Run current through a wire between magnets, and it gets shoved sideways.
Loop it, and one side goes up, the other goes down. A twist.
But after half a turn, the push reverses, and it gets stuck.
So a split ring flips the current every half turn, and it never stops.
Magnets. Current. Flip. That's an electric motor.
Which machine should we break down next?
